title: The Unequal Diffusion of Honesty and Dishonesty in Workplace Networks
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences design. Autoregressive linear probability model of behavior switching on the count of opposite-behavior neighbors (continuous peer exposure) with market and month fixed effects and time-varying controls.
design_notes: Clerk-market-month panel (4,621 clerk-months); market and month FE, not unit FE; peer effect identified from algorithmic staffing as a natural experiment.
estimators_reported: OLS linear probability model with market and month FE
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Proprietary firm data.
